# Preparations for the Nuka World on Tour update on December 6th, 2022

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_90_nukaknights-post-nwot-prepare.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In our article [Update] Coming changes in the 'Nuka World on Tour' update on December 6th, 2022 you have already read a summary of what awaits you in the update. There are a few things you can do here to get started straight away when the servers are online again.

## Infinite Ammo Storage Crate (Fallout 1st)

**If you have Fallout 1st:** Log out of your CAMP before the update so that after the update you can immediately set up the new infinite ammunition storage box and store all the ammunition you don't currently need. A survival tent with an ammunition storage box will not be available immediately. That's still a long time coming.

## Nuka World on Tour Discover places

Make sure that you have discovered the places **Lewisburg** (everyone should have discovered it) and also the "**Abandoned Mineshaft 2**". The Abandoned Mine Shaft 2 is the target you have to hit with a nuclear missile for the new endgame event Seismic Activity to start.

![](/uploads/nukaworldontour-map.jpg) 

![](/uploads/fallout76-20.11.2022-14-16-31.jpg) 

## CAMP placement in the Nukezone?

Check whether your current CAMP is in the immediate vicinity of **Abandoned Mineshaft 2**. If so, you should consider moving. Many nuclear missiles will now hit there to start the new event and fight the Ultracite Titan.

The 3 nuke zones in the picture above make it easy to see where your CAMP is safe.

## Farm thirst quencher ammo

As you know, in "Nuka World on Tour" you can get the new water gun "Thirst Quencher" aka "Thirst Zapper". And as you can see in the article PTS: Everything about the Thirst Zapper (Nuka World on Tour), this new weapon with the **Nuka-Cola Quantum Mod** is a really nice toy. 

Of course you need Nuka-Cola Quantum for this. So if you want to take precautions, farm or buy as much Nuka-Cola Quantum as you can get.

![](/uploads/fallout76-18.11.2022-21-54-31.jpg)

## Thirst Quencher Legendary roll

And you certainly want to roll the thirst quencher in the legendary version, e.g. like this:

![](/uploads/fallout76-18.11.2022-22-01-09.jpg)

Then you shouldn't forget to have some **legendary modules** and **legendary cores** ready.

## Have melee weapon ready for Seismic Activity (Ultracite Titan).

In the article PTS: Everything about the new final boss event 'Seismic Activity' in Ash Heap / Nuka World on Tour you have already learned that the Ultracite Titan has a special mechanic. You must first destroy the Ultracite Crystals in close combat before the Ultracite Titan becomes vulnerable.

Therefore, you should have a melee weapon ready for the event that you can quickly switch to. Alternatively, you can hit your weapon with the butt, but personally I always prefer to switch to a sensible melee weapon. It doesn't matter what kind.

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_80_20221014081121-1.jpg)

You can also farm **Nuka Cade points** with a melee weapon by playing the "Hau den Luka" game in the Nuka Cade tent.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-nukacadepoints-youtube.jpg)

## Complete the game board and collect rewards

Don't forget to complete the current Season 10 board and collect all the rewards you have unlocked. This is only possible until the servers are taken offline for maintenance on December 6th, 2022 at 4 p.m.

![](/uploads/5c0aff2b-dc1b-4635-908e-155745a091a4.jpg)

## How do you prepare?

Do you also have any tips for preparation? Write them in the comments.
